source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 3. The following BIOS settings paths are from the Intel reference platform. Locations of these settings may be different on your BIOS implementation Customer Scripts (CScripts) Enabling The following is a quick reference of the key BIOS knobs for CScripts: • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Processor Configuration > Lock Chipset = Disable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Processor Configuration > MSR Lock Control = Disable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > IIO Configuration > DFX Global Configuration > — EV DFX Features = Enable — Disable BIOS Done = [X] ELOG Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > eMCA Settings > — EMCA Error Support= Enable — EMCA Logging Support= Enable — Corrected Error eLog = Enable — Memory Error eLog = Enable — Processor Error eLog = Enable Error Reporting Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > WHEA Settings > — WHEA Support = Enable — WHEA Log Memory Error = Enable — WHEA Log Processor Error = Enable — WHEA Log PCI Error = Enable Error Injection Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > — System Errors = Enable — System Memory Poison = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Error Injection Settings > — MCA Bank Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA PCIe* Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA PCIe* Error Action Table = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > IIO Error Enabling > — IIO/PCH Global Error Support = Enable — IIO MCA Support = Disable — IIO eDPC Support = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > PCIE Error Enabling > PCIe* Corrected Error Threshold Counter = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > PCIE Error Enabling > PCIe AER Corrected Errors = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > EMCA Settings > LMCE Support = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Memory Error Enabling > Memory Corrected Error = Enable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Uncore Configuration > Uncore General Configuration > Directory Mode Enable = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > Miscellaneous Configuration > Enable DAM Pin = Enable Firmware First Model • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > EMCA Settings > — EMCA Logging Support = Enable — EMCA CMCI-SMI Morphing = EMCA gen2 CSMI — EMCA CMCI-SMI Threshold = 0 — EMCA MCA-SMI Enable = EMCA gen 2 - MSMI • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > IIO Error Enabling > OS Native AER Support = Disable Crash Log • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Crash Log Enabling > CPU CrashLog Feature = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Crash Log Enabling > PCH CrashLog Feature = Disable 4. Other OS Notes You can use grub2-mkconfig to specify "ras=cec_disable" by modifying /etc/default/grub's "GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX" with "ras=cec_disable". 【During Test】 1. Specific BIOS setup : • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Memory Error Enabling > — Spare Interrupt = SMI • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Memory Configuration > Memory RAS Configuration > — Correctable Error Threshold = 2 — Trigger SW Error Threshold= Disabled — ADDDC Sparing = Enable • Socket Configuration > Memory Configuration > — Enforce Population POR = Disable • Disabling this knob is not required but was disabled because a non-POR memory population was used to create this recipe. It is recommended to have a POR memory population. 2. Establish 1 bank VLS region as described in One Bank VLS Region. 3. Halt the system for error injections. >>> halt() 4. The hardware per rank CECC error thresholds were set to "2" so inject two CECC errors to the buddy rank and bank. In step 1, a bank VLS region was established with the buddy rank as chip-select 0x4 and bank 0x1. Chip-select decodes to {DIMM, rank, sub-channel}. Use these DIMM, rank, sub-channel, and bank values as the new error injection target. >>> ei.mem.memDevs(dev0=0, dev0msk=0x3, dev1=1, dev1msk=0x0) >>> ei.mem.injectMemError(socket=0, channel=0, dimm=1, rank=0, sub_channel=0, bank_group=0, bank=1, errType="ce", verbose=True, sub_rank=0, ps_ch=0, showErrorRegs=True, checkEInjLock=False) >>> ei.mem.memDevs(dev0=0, dev0msk=0x3, dev1=1, dev1msk=0x0) >>> ei.mem.injectMemError(socket=0, channel=0, dimm=1, rank=0, sub_channel=0, bank_group=0, bank=1, errType="ce", verbose=True, sub_rank=0, ps_ch=0, showErrorRegs=True, checkEInjLock=False) 5. Check that the per rank CECC error threshold has been met. >>> ras.mem.adddc_status_check(socket=0, mc=0) 6. Resume the system so BIOS can perform its SMM flow. >>> go() 7. Reverse bank VLS and two bank VLS sparing flows are expected so copy_in_progress should be 1. >>> sv.socket0.compute0.uncore.memss.mc0.ch0.mcchan.sparing_patrol_status.show() 8. Verify the 2 bank VLS regions. Note that the 1st failed bank has buddied with rank 0x6 which aligns with the expected buddy rank selection order and that the 2nd failed bank was buddied with the expected rank and next available bank according to the BIOS algorithm. >>> ras.mem.adddc_status_check(socket=0, mc=0)

disposition_reason: Striking the buddy rank within the protected bank makes the current replacement unsafe, so BIOS must reverse or reassign that pairing before establishing the second region. That causal path is different from simply adding a region on the failed rank. The complete before/after failed/buddy map and pinned allocation order are therefore the oracle; the corrected-error logs and transient copy bit alone cannot prove safe re-pairing. test_case.purpose: Verify ADDDC handles a threshold event on the buddy rank inside the current VLS region by reversing/reassigning the first bank relationship and creating the expected second bank VLS according to BIOS allocation order.
required_package: GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM/chip-select topology and POR disposition
Initial failed/buddy region plus CS0x4/bank1-to-DIMM1 decode
Expected reverse first-region rank0x6 and second-region buddy/next-bank algorithm
SMM timeout, serial/OOB recovery and restoration plan
test_case.test_command: Capture platform/RAS settings and initial failed/buddy bank/rank map; verify buddy CS0x4 bank1 decodes to DIMM1/rank0/subchannel0; halt; set dev0=0 mask0x3 and inject exactly two CEs at that buddy location; confirm threshold; go once; optionally sample copy; compare ADDDC region/control to prove two regions, first failed bank buddy rank0x6 and approved second failed/buddy/next-bank selection; restore and verify health.
